_scope: Family-level hints for translating ogds-elements components to the USWDS registry. ogds-elements is a web-component reimplementation of USWDS 3.x patterns, so most translations are structural with the ogds custom classes replaced by usa-* classes; behavior moves from the web component to the USWDS JS bundle.

mismatches: ogds-alert has no emergency variant; USWDS adds usa-alert--emergency
ogds icon is a CSS content image on img.ogds-alert__icon; USWDS embeds the icon in the stylesheet background
ogds heading is slotted arbitrary-level markup; USWDS uses .usa-alert__heading
alert.notes: Carry the heading element over — USWDS also expects a heading inside the alert

mismatches: ogds-accordion is native <details> children under a class root; USWDS uses button + hidden div per item inside .usa-accordion
USWDS requires its JS bundle for the toggle behavior; ogds is native details (no JS)
ogds with-icon/plus/right icon variants have no USWDS equivalent
USWDS ships no expand/collapse-all control — compose one with usa-button and custom JS
accordion-toggle.notes: Keep the controls relationship and the label-flip-on-open behavior when composing

mismatches: ogds bundles its own grid/accordion styles; USWDS expects the global stylesheet
ogds lang/tld attributes swap translation tables; USWDS ships separate markup per locale
ogds-header renders a <dialog> drawer below 64rem; USWDS uses a toggled nav container
ogds secondary nav is a slot; USWDS .usa-nav__secondary
ogds submenus are native details/summary; USWDS uses buttons + hidden sublists with JS
ogds current-page indicator keys off aria-current='page'; USWDS uses usa-current class
primary-nav.notes: Move aria-current='page' to usa-current class + aria-current on the link

mismatches: ogds task-list has status badges and a completion counter; USWDS process-list is a numbered step list without status
ogds blocked state (cannot-start-yet) has no USWDS equivalent
task-list.notes: Use usa-process-list when the flow is strictly linear; keep the task-list pattern when tasks are non-sequential

mismatches: Status badges (In progress / Cannot start yet) have no USWDS equivalent — approximate with usa-tag
